subject.title: fix(memory-core): defer dreaming sweep when main session has active runs

question: Should dreaming use a core-owned background-maintenance admission lease, or should process-global run state become a supported Plugin SDK scheduling API?
rationale: The decision establishes the permanent scheduler owner and compatibility contract; a one-time global count cannot provide full-sweep mutual exclusion or a precise foreground-session signal.

options.title: Core admission lease
options.body: Keep scheduling policy in core and hold an admission lease through all asynchronous dreaming work.

options.title: Supported Plugin SDK API
options.body: Publish precise run-class semantics and complete all SDK compatibility surfaces before plugins use global run state.

options.title: Accept temporary mitigation
options.body: Land the snapshot only with explicit acceptance of residual overlap and a named removal plan.

recommendation.title: Core admission lease
recommendation.body: Keep scheduling policy in core and hold an admission lease through all asynchronous dreaming work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and hardened the dreaming lifecycle and is the strongest verified history owner for deciding how the sweep should participate in admission.
